title: Research local LLM inference on constrained GPU memory
prompt: Research practical options for running an approximately 8B-parameter language model on a GPU with about 8 GB of VRAM. Compare quantization, context length, inference/runtime choices, and likely trade-offs. Prefer primary documentation from the relevant runtime and model projects. Separate measured facts from general guidance; do not promise that a model will fit without accounting for runtime overhead and context/KV cache.
requested_dimensions: Runtime options supported by primary documentation
Performance and quality trade-offs with evidence
Practical recommendation with assumptions and caveats
acceptance_criteria: At least three relevant primary sources are cited
VRAM claims state their assumptions or are labeled as estimates
The report distinguishes model weights from runtime/KV-cache memory
Recommendations are tied to the stated hardware constraint
Unsupported precise speed claims are omitted
